title: RBI Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Banks Medical Consultant Posts
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Bank Medical Consultant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS can grab this opportunity and apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply for the RBI Notification 2026 . Here we have mentioned more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
